sources.summary: As we enter the next era, what will be the defining measure of our progress? Every industry has a word that shapes how it thinks. For pilots, it’s safety. For insurers, it’s risk. For the semiconductor industry, it’s yield. Yield does not ask how elegant the solution is, how many years it took or what... The post The yield imperative: Turning AI infrastructure into useful intelligence appeared first on The Official Microsoft Blog .
sources.summary_zh: 當我們邁入下一個時代，衡量我們進步的決定性標準是什麼？每個行業都有一個關鍵字，它塑造了該行業的思維方式。對飛行員來說，是安全；對保險公司來說，是風險；對半導體產業來說，是良率。良率並不關心解決方案是否完美，耗時多少年，或其他什麼…這篇文章《良率至上：將人工智慧基礎設施轉化為實用智慧》最初發表於微軟官方部落格。
